messages:
maria: quick heads-up — i'm opening a PR to merge the 429, timeout, and context-limit notes into a single troubleshooting runbook. goal is: one compact page + tiny SDK snippets + a reproducible harness for QA. draft link: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4821 :spiral_note_pad:

jin: nice. can we make the harness a dockerized tiny server that returns 429 with controllable timing? QA wants deterministic repros. :+1:

leo: agree. also need a one-paragraph UX blurb about fallback behavior (what clients should expect when we downgrade to shorter context or to a cheaper model). short and prescriptive. :eyes:

sam: i can add the node/python snippets. proposing these patterns: retry-with-backoff + capture `x-retry-after` header and a graceful fallback to cached summary. will paste draft code in the PR.

maria: sketch for the harness in the PR: a small express server with endpoint `/burst` that returns 429 when qps > threshold and supports `?window=ms` to force latency. idea is we can run `./scripts/sim-429.sh` in CI to smoke the runbook examples.

jin: can you add a short checklist in the doc for QA: reproduce, assert headers, assert retry backoff, check metric `client.429-retries`? otherwise we miss flaky cases.

leo: one more ask — add a note about streaming interruptions (resume behavior). link to the streaming-resume doc. keep it 2–3 sentences.

sam: node snippet (mini):
```
// node SDK pseudo
const r = await Redwood.generate({ model: 'gpt-small', prompt });
if (r.status === 429) {
  // look for x-retry-after
  const wait = parseInt(r.headers['x-retry-after'] || '0', 10);
  await sleep(wait || backoff.next());
  return retry();
}
```

maria: perfect. can you also include an example that trims prompt context as a fallback (2-sentence note + code).

sam: added quick trim snippet in the PR comment. also included guidance: prefer prefix caching over arbitrary trim where possible.

docs-bot: lint-check: docs/style.md violations in `error-ref/429.md` — line 42 (use present-tense imperative), line 71 (missing code-block language).

maria: thanks bot — i'll fix style and add fenced lang markers.

jin: quick thought on telemetry: add a recommended event payload for `client_429_handled` so platform can surface regressions. fields: `model`, `fallback_strategy`, `retry_count`, `latency_ms`. keeps it minimal.

leo: assigning ownership: maria for prose + CI harness, sam for SDK snippets, jin for QA checklist + telemetry props. i'll volunteer to do the final pass for the UX blurb and the streaming note.

maria: OK landing plan: open PR today, wait for snippets and telemetry payloads, then tag `@eng-qa` for a small smoke run with the docker harness. aiming to merge by EOB tomorrow.

sam: noted. i'll drop the python snippet and a curl example for the harness into the PR in next 30m.

jin: i'll prepare the QA ticket template and add test steps that use `sim-429` script.

leo: :rocket: thanks all. will follow up if i spot anything during review.

maria: thanks — ping me if anything blocks.
